verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a design tool, so this axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows it offering its own reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to a source. The available evidence covers related but different features: applying a design system, importing real code components, and sliders. The only mention of reusable components (comm-7) describes components built inside PenPot, a separate tool reached through its MCP server, so it does not count as Claude Design's own capability.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source
